summary: Final iteration of nav-bar fix chain (167-173). Tested NavTabs flex-wrap + <header> min-h-16 fix across 1920, 1440, 1366, 1280, 1200, 1024 widths as super_admin (all 7 nav items visible: BOM Management + Production + Procurement + Supplier Management + Inventory Management + Master Data + Administration). Result: NO horizontal scrolling anywhere at any width; ZERO body/header overflow (overflowElems empty at all widths); inner container overflow-x is 'visible' (not 'auto'/'scroll'); tabs wrap onto 2-4 rows as width narrows; header grows: 64px @1920 -> 81px @1440/1366/1280 -> 119px @1200 -> 156px @1024. No overlap between nav items, user menu (Ankit Sharma), and SAP/ERP status badges - user menu stays right-anchored separately from wrapping tabs container. Production + Administration dropdowns open cleanly at 1280 (wrapped state). InventoryPage and AdminPage at 1280 also show consistent min-h-16 behavior (no clipping). Mobile 390: hamburger drawer opens correctly, unaffected. Teal header background spans full wrapped height with no clipping (verified via screenshots at 1024 and 1280).
critical_code_review_comments: NavTabs.jsx flex-wrap solution is correct and matches user's explicit no-scroll requirement. Header taller trade-off is intended.

min-h-16 bulk-applied across ~24 page files - verified 3 (BomExplorer, Inventory, Admin) render header consistently at 1280 with wrapped nav; assumed consistent for other pages since header markup is identical.

Minor: at 1200/1024 the header uses ~119-156px vertical space which pushes page content down noticeably; acceptable per user's explicit ask (prefers wrap over scroll), but worth confirming this is the intended UX outside of super_admin worst case.
